en: Black‑and‑white view over a small spa or resort town nestled in a forested valley in the mountains. In the foreground there is a wooden bench by a tree beside a hillside path, overlooking the town below. The town consists of several large villa‑style buildings and guesthouses with steep roofs, surrounded by dense coniferous forest. A prominent church with a tall square tower and spire stands slightly left of center. Hills covered with trees rise in the background, with mist softening the distant landscape. There is a small rectangular sign fixed to the tree near the bench and some handwritten numeric markings along the left border of the image, as in an old photographic or postcard print.
